Japan's Yen Hits 40-Year Low Amid Market Expectations

The Japanese yen has reached a 40-year low, prompting market expectations of a potential economic boost. This development is expected to have far-reaching implications for Japan's economy and global markets. The government has stated that it will take action in response to the yen's decline.
